releaseNotes: Backup and restore. Settings > Export all data now works in the Android app (it opens the share menu, so you can save the backup to Google Drive, email or WhatsApp), and the new Settings > Restore from backup brings all your data back. The backup now also includes your exercise photos and equipment notes. Coming from v4.1 or older: this version has a new signing key, so uninstall the old app first. That deletes the data in the old app; if you want to keep your training logs, contact A. Craens before uninstalling.
